title: JoyaniaMC
description: We are a Family Friendly vanilla(ish) Minecraft server
body:
A vanilla ish family friendly Minecraft server
JoyaniaMC is a family-friendly Minecraft server that focuses on community. Most features added to the server are decided by our community, and we ensure players can enjoy and have a good time. Joyania welcomes everyone of all ages, whether you're a family member just hanging out or someone looking to have fun. You can visit us at play.joyania.xyz on any Minecraft version, Java or Bedrock!
